title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1969-12-19
source: 7" Master Soundboard Reels > Cassette > DAT > CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an electrifying Dec 1969 show featuring smoking renditions of Cumberland Blues, Hard to Handle and Black Peter.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the band's fire‑brand performance, highlighting standout moments on Cumberland Blues, Hard to Handle, Black Peter and The Other One. The recording is a soundboard source with no reported audio flaws, though one reviewer objects to the post‑show track splitting of The Other One. Overall the set feels energetic and historically significant as a prelude to the Dead’s acoustic era.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high reviewer scores (mostly 4‑5 stars) praising musical intensity and no complaints about sound quality, indicating a strong show plus a clean soundboard recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific audio issues mentioned; reviewers focus on performance rather than any flaws, implying a clear and well‑balanced capture.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as epic and on fire, with a cohesive energy that carries through the night; reviewers note it as an important pre‑acoustic period for the band.

band_member_comments.Phil: Mentioned as being 'stuck somewhere' during this period, hinting at his role in the band's shift toward acoustic performances.
